preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000 and 1 <= n * m <= 200000 for n, m in [(int(line.split()[0]) if line.strip() else 0, int(line.split()[1]) if len(line.split()) > 1 else 0) for line in stdin.splitlines()[:1]])
preconditions.description: Input dimensions n and m are integers where 1 ≤ n, m ≤ 1000 and 1 ≤ n·m ≤ 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly n+1 lines: the first line contains n and m, and the next n lines contain m integers each.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(f) <= n * m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for f in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each f_{i,j} is an integer between 1 and n·m inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len({int(f) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for f in line.split()}) == n * m
preconditions.description: All f_{i,j} are distinct (permutation of 1 to n·m).

postconditions.description: Output is a non-negative integer representing the count of pleasant segments [l, r], where 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n·m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n * m for l in range(1, n * m + 1) for r in range(l, n * m + 1) if (l, r) in pleasant_segments) and len(pleasant_segments) == int(stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: A segment [l, r] is pleasant if and only if the set S of cells (i, j) with l ≤ f_{i,j} ≤ r forms a connected acyclic graph (tree) under 4-directional adjacency (up, down, left, right). The output counts all such valid segments.

postconditions.expression: len(pleasant_segments) == sum(1 for l in range(1, n * m + 1) for r in range(l, n * m + 1) if is_pleasant_segment(l, r))
postconditions.description: The output is the total count of all valid pleasant segments [l, r], where is_pleasant_segment(l, r) checks if the induced subgraph of cells with f_{i,j} in [l, r] is a tree (connected and acyclic).
